task.title: M4: Graph starts collapsed with an Expand all / Collapse all toggle
task.description:
Revert the graph's initial state to collapsed (direct children of the repo root visible, every deeper directory collapsed, as before the fully-expanded change) and add an Expand all / Collapse all control next to Fit and Re-layout. Expand all opens every directory compound and runs the full layout once, then fits; Collapse all returns to the initial collapsed state, re-aggregates edges, lays out, and fits. Per-directory double-click expand/collapse keeps working in between, and the control's label reflects the predominant state (show Expand all when anything is collapsed, Collapse all when everything is open). The default fcose quality from the previous story stays.

Acceptance criteria:
- Opening #view=graph on Capacitor shows the top-level directories with deeper directories collapsed (the pre-expansion behavior) and the summary counts match that state.
- Expand all shows every file node and all edges (Capacitor: 699 of 699) within about a second; Collapse all returns to the initial counts.
- Double-click expand/collapse still works after either action, and cycles, tooltips, Fit, and Re-layout are unchanged.
- Switching views and back, or loading another snapshot, starts collapsed again.
- Headless Chrome check covers both actions on Capacitor and codeviz with no console errors.
